core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt:
def orbit (n : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => n
  | k + 1 => step (orbit n k)

def Canonical (n : Nat) (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) : Prop :=
  0 < L ∧ (∀ i, i < L → d i ≤ 9) ∧ 0 < d (L - 1) ∧ value d L = n
core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: Positive width, decimal digit bounds, nonzero leading digit, and numeric value.

core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt:
def columnSum (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  d i + reflected d L i
core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: Actual coefficient from a digit and its reflected digit.

core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt:
def carry (q : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | i + 1 => (q i + carry q i) / 10

core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: Original update using the actual final carry to choose the reflection width.

core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt:
def nextWidth (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) : Nat :=
  if carry q L = 0 then L else L + 1

def Admissible (L : Nat) (q : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  0 < L ∧ 0 < q 0 ∧ (∀ i, i < L → q i ≤ 18) ∧
  (∀ i, i < L → q i = q (L - 1 - i)) ∧
  (∀ i, i < L → i = L - 1 - i → q i % 2 = 0)
core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: Exact finite coefficient-word assumptions; irrelevant infinite tails remain unrestricted.

core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt:
def iterPairs (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) : Nat → Nat × (Nat → Nat)
  | 0 => (L,q)
  | k+1 =>
    let prev := iterPairs q L k
    (nextWidth prev.2 prev.1, nextColumns prev.2 prev.1)
core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: Exact pair state: width in .1 and coefficient function in .2.

core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt: def reset (c : Nat) : Nat := if c = 18 then 1 else 0
core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: The calculated reset carry associated to coefficient 0 or 18.
Nonempty maximal interval [a,b) within the represented width.
One-step descendant selected by the actual carries.

core_semantics_and_definitions.source_excerpt:
def track (q : Nat → Nat) (L c a b : Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (a, b)
  | t + 1 =>
    descendant (iterPairs q L t).2 (iterPairs q L t).1 c
      (track q L c a b t).1 (track q L c a b t).2
core_semantics_and_definitions.purpose: Iteration of one ancestry along the original pair-state orbit.

theorem orbit_ancestry_extinct (n : Nat) (d : Nat → Nat) (L c a b : Nat)
    (hcan : Canonical n d L) (hc : c = 0 ∨ c = 18)
    (hr : MaximalRun (columnSum d L) L c a b) :
    (∀ t, ∃ e, Canonical (orbit n t) e (iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).1 ∧
        ∀ i, i < (iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).1 →
          columnSum e (iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).1 i = (iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).2 i) ∧
    (∀ t, (track (columnSum d L) L c a b t).1 < (track (columnSum d L) L c a b t).2 →
        MaximalRun (iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).2 (iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).1 c
          (track (columnSum d L) L c a b t).1 (track (columnSum d L) L c a b t).2 ∧
        t + lowerPotential ((iterPairs (columnSum d L) L t).2 0) ≤
          4 * (b - a - 1) + lowerPotential (columnSum d L 0)) ∧
    (∀ t, 4 * (b - a) - 3 + lowerPotential (columnSum d L 0) ≤ t →
        (track (columnSum d L) L c a b t).2 ≤ (track (columnSum d L) L c a b t).1)
available_in_closure_helpers.purpose: Bundle numeric representation, survival, and extinction for one ancestry in an actual integer orbit.
available_in_closure_helpers.requires: Canonical n d L; c = 0 or 18; MaximalRun (columnSum d L) L c a b.

available_in_closure_helpers.declaration:
theorem central_run_step (q : Nat → Nat) (L c a : Nat) (ha : Admissible L q)
    (hc : c = 0 ∨ c = 18) (hr : MaximalRun q L c a (L - a)) :
    (descendant q L c a (L - a)).2 - (descendant q L c a (L - a)).1 =
      (if carry q L = 0 then
        (if carry q a = reset c then L - 2 * a else L - 2 * a - 2)
      else L - 2 * a - 1) ∧
    ((descendant q L c a (L - a)).1 < (descendant q L c a (L - a)).2 →
      MaximalRun (nextColumns q L) (nextWidth q L) c
        (descendant q L c a (L - a)).1 (descendant q L c a (L - a)).2)
available_in_closure_helpers.purpose: Give the exact truncated length of a maximal central run after one actual step.
available_in_closure_helpers.requires: Admissible L q; c = 0 or 18; MaximalRun q L c a (L-a).
